name: Garden
tagline: A bed of steps: seeds sprout in new-leaf green, blooms stay, and the sun comes out only when nothing needs you.
mood: Calm and tended, a touch whimsical: a cool green greenhouse with one pale sun, glanced into, never a cartoon.
rationale: A run of steps already has a lifecycle, so the theme draws it as one: todo is a seed, doing is the one sprout in new-leaf chartreuse, done is a bloom in the deeper green that stays, so young and grown read as two different greens at a glance. The greenhouse is cool on purpose: there is no terracotta anywhere (that colour belongs to Claude's own creature above the prompt), and the only warm glyph is the sun ☼, which stands in the health cell of the band and the pane header only while the run is working and nothing waits on the person. Warmth at the band's left edge therefore means carry on, and its absence, a red `!` in its place, means come here. This sample is that moment (D1 waits), so the still shows no sun; answering D1 is what brings it out, a one-shot the person earns. The spacing complaint is answered with a stated grid: a 3-cell gutter every row shares, one blank line above every section, no fill rules (the only line is the soil under the bed), and a right column that ends at column 71 in every section, so sha, agent, age and counts line up instead of drifting.
tokenMap: Meaning stays on theme keys; two raw hex pairs carry the personality, each on one glyph only. bg/fg/dim: the terminal's own background, `text` and `dimColor` (their palette hexes are the preview's stand-ins). accent, new-leaf chartreuse (#c5e07a dark, #5e7a12 light): hex, the sprout ⚘ only, the doing step's gutter cell and the glyph in the band's step label; the doing meaning rides on the glyph and bold, the hex only says young leaf, and it is kept lighter and yellower than the bloom green (11.7:1 against success's 7.7:1 on the dark reference ground; olive against green on light) so doing and done never read as one tone. accent2, pale sun (#f2e3a0 dark, #a07c00 light): hex, the sun ☼ only, the health cell in the band and the pane header while the run is working and nothing waits on the person; it is the one warm glyph on the screen and is absent from this still because D1 waits. On dark it is clearly lighter and paler than `warning` (luminance 0.76 against 0.42 for the stand-in and 0.59 for Claude Code's amber); on light, paper does not allow lighter while holding 3:1, so there the two part by hue (a gold with less orange in it than the amber) and by place (the header gutter only, and the sun is never shown while a `?` or `!` is open), not by lightness. Both pairs are picked by the hooks module from the `theme` row of `$.config.list()`: a string value starting `light` takes the light pair, one starting `dark` the dark pair, and anything else (an unknown or auto value, an unreadable row) the light pair, which clears 3:1 on both grounds (sprout 4.7:1 light, 3.5:1 dark; sun 3.7:1 light, 4.4:1 dark); a `config.set` hook on key `theme` re-picks once the change is written. No `claude` key and no terracotta anywhere. Chrome (the branch name, the soil line, the section glyphs ❀ ✦) is the `subtle` theme key, previewed as dim; it never carries meaning, so the done green stays unique. bg2: unused at rest; the `hover` background of keyed row Boxes on terminal and desktop. success: `success`, blooms ✿, done rows' glyph, the ✿ A chip, gate passed, the meter's filled cells and the finished health ✿. warning: `warning`, `? n`, `~`, `waits on D1`, Rulings. error: `error`, `!` needs-you (health and section glyph), `✗` gate red, `! n`, blocked steps.

otherTabs: Plan lists every bed with the same step rows as the overview: a done bed folds to one row `✿ A API … 5/5` on its own soil line, the current bed is open, a todo bed is `· C Docs … 0/7`, and pressing a bed header folds or unfolds it; Log keeps the time in a 6-wide gutter Box, `✿` on `done:` lines and `✦` on Rulings in warning, with the same blank-line-above-section rhythm. Step details put the step's lifecycle glyph in the gutter beside the title, 8-wide dim labels in a fixed-width Box (status, note, commit, gate, agents, drift, asks) and `b: ← Overview   k: Prev   j: Next` as plain Buttons with their hotkeys on the top row; Needs you draws each question as a card with `?` in the gutter, its why and `blocks B4` in dim, option Buttons with the recommended one as `primary`, and answered items as `✿ D1 per seat   Claude has it`. With nothing waiting, the header and the band lead with the pale sun `☼` in place of `!` and NEEDS YOU is absent (NOTICED keeps `~` in its gutter); a finished run reads `✿ Add team billing   took 3h40m` with the meter all blooms; an empty run shows `· Nothing planted yet` under PLAN.
glyphs: todo `·` seed (dim) · doing `⚘` sprout (U+2698, accent chartreuse hex, bold) · done `✿` bloom (U+273F, success) · blocked `!` (error) · skipped `–` (dim) · current phase `▸` (plain bold) with done beds `✿ A` (success) and todo beds `· C` (dim) as chips · decision `?` (warning), blocker `!` (error), drift `~` (warning): unchanged, shared with the other kit mods and matched by drawBand's `[?!~] n` regex · health: `☼` working (U+263C, accent2 pale-sun hex, the only warm glyph, shown only while no `?` or `!` is open), `!` needs you (error, as healthOf today), `✗` gate red (error), `✿` finished (success); no emoji-property glyphs anywhere · section glyphs: NEEDS YOU reuses the health `!` in error (or `~` in warning when only noticed), PLAN `❀` (U+2740) and SIGNALS `✦` in chrome (`subtle`) · meter cells: filled `✿` (success), empty `▁` bare soil (dim), 10 in the band and 20 in the pane at width ≥ 60, so the seed `·` is the only dot on the screen · soil line `▁` (U+2581, subtle) · fallback map when the font lacks the dingbats: sprout `✧` (same chartreuse), bloom `◆`, PLAN `◇`, SIGNALS keeps `✦`, the sun keeps `☼` · all width-1 BMP; ⚘ ✿ ❀ ✧ ✦ ☼ are East-Asian-width N and none has the Unicode Emoji property; `·` `▁` are ambiguous-width like today's `━ ─`.
spacingRules: Grid: col 1 margin, col 2 the glyph gutter, col 3 space, text from col 4; every row of every section uses it, so the glyphs read as one vertical row of plants, with the sun (when out) at the top of that same column. Right column: right-aligned, last cell at col 71, col 72 empty; always dim (sha, agent + tool, age, counts) except the chips (`✿ A` success, `▸ B` bold, `· C` dim) and `waits on D1` in warning; at least 2 cells between left text and the right column, the left text clips first. Sections: exactly one blank line above each label; labels are bold caps with their glyph in the gutter and no fill rule; the only line in the pane is the soil `▁` closing the bed, drawn in the text column (cols 4 to 71). The footer has one blank line above; the engine draws each tab's `1: ` hotkey prefix, tabs are separated by 3 spaces, and the active tab is bold with no colour. Signals labels sit in a 6-wide Box from col 4 with a 1-cell gap, so values start at col 11; secondary facts follow their value after 2 spaces. Separators everywhere are two spaces, not middots: the seed `·` is the only dot on the screen (the empty meter cells are `▁`). The meter and its count are 2 cells apart in the band and the pane alike. Never adjacent: a section label never follows a content row without a blank line; the two band count badges are 2 cells apart with a 2-cell minimum gap before them. Each hex appears at most once per view: the sprout once in the pane (the doing row's gutter) and once in the band (the step label), the sun once in the pane (the header's gutter) and once in the band (the health cell), never on the same row as each other, and the sun never in a NEEDS YOU or NOTICED row where warning lives.
desktopNotes: Proportional font, so nothing is aligned by spaces: each row is a flex row with a `flexGrow` spacer and a fixed-width right Box, which keeps the right column aligned; Signals and step-detail labels are fixed-width Boxes (6 and 8) with the value in a sibling Box, never padEnd. The soil `▁` line is dropped (it would wrap) and the blank line above the next label does the separating; the meter stays a 10-cell `✿✿✿✿▁▁▁▁▁▁` run, which tolerates glyph width variance because nothing is aligned after it on that row except the count. Sections keep the gutter glyph and bold label. The two hexes need nothing extra on desktop (a paint prop takes hex there too) and the pair is picked from the same `theme` row; the sprout's sway and the sunrise run in the same 1x1 Clients. The band is terminal and desktop only; on desktop the two-space separators hold. VS Code and mobile draw the static frame (no Client): the sprout plain chartreuse, the health glyph plain (the sun pale gold when it is out). Mobile keeps every row but lets long titles wrap under the text column.

animation.idea: The sprout sways and the sun comes out. Idle: the doing step's gutter cell is a 1x1 Client whose chartreuse `⚘` eases between full strength and a trough that never drops below 3:1 on the ground (dark #c5e07a to #7f9252, 40% toward the ground, 5.0:1; light #5e7a12 to #7d943f, 20%, 3.3:1) on a 4 s sine, a slow sway without changing the glyph. Events: when the last open decision or blocker is answered, the header's health cell (a second 1x1 Client) swaps `!` for `☼`, which rises from the dim tone to the pale sun over 800 ms and rests: the one moment of warmth, earned by the person's own answer. A step marked done ripens: its cell plays `⚘` turning `✿` from chartreuse to success over 600 ms and rests as `✿`, and the next step's seed shows its sprout at once. A gate pass while the sun is out pulses the sun once toward higher contrast and back over 400 ms (dark toward #fff6c8, light toward #6c5b0d, never toward the paper); while `!` stands, a gate pass adds nothing at the health cell. A run finishing turns the sun into the last bloom `✿` over 600 ms, then everything rests. The band's text never animates.
animation.trigger: Idle sway while a step is doing; one-shot sunrise when needs-you empties (D1 answered); one-shot ripening when a step is marked done; one-shot pulse on a gate pass while the sun is out; one-shot `☼` to `✿` when the run finishes. A question raised replaces the sun with `!` at once, static: bad news never animates.
animation.cadence: 2 fps while idle (a 4 s sway is 8 frames); 0.5 fps when a key was pressed in the last 3 s; stopped and shown as the static frame on mobile, VS Code and when the pane is not focused for 60 s. One-shots run at up to 10 fps for their 400 to 800 ms and then stop.
animation.element: Client (terminal and desktop), 1x1 cell at the doing row's gutter and 1x1 at the header's health cell; the hooks module picks the hex pairs from the `theme` config row (dark: sprout #c5e07a, trough #7f9252, sun #f2e3a0, pulse #fff6c8, sunrise from #7c8c7c; light and fallback: sprout #5e7a12, trough #7d943f, sun #a07c00, pulse #6c5b0d, sunrise from #76857a) and passes them, with the step, gate and needs-you transitions, to the Clients as props via update(); each Client only interpolates between the hexes it is given. None on mobile and VS Code.
animation.staticFrame: `⚘` in chartreuse at full strength in the gutter of the doing row; the header cell shows the health as it stands, plain: `!` here because D1 waits, `☼` in pale sun when nothing waits, `✗` or `✿` otherwise. The mock above is the static frame.

feasibility: Everything is Box/Text/Button plus two 1x1 Clients; no Raster, no Image, no borders. The two accents are raw hex on Text `color` (the engine's Color type admits a theme key or any hex string), applied to one glyph each, so no meaning depends on them; the light/dark pick reads the `theme` row through `$.config.list()` (its value is the row's ConfigValue) and re-picks from a pass-through `config.set` hook on key `theme`, both documented engine calls; an unknown value falls back to the light pair, which holds 3:1 on dark and light grounds alike. Contrast on the reference grounds: sprout 11.7:1 dark and 4.7:1 light, sway trough 5.0:1 and 3.3:1, sun 13.3:1 dark and 3.7:1 light; the sun separates from `warning` by lightness on dark and only by hue and place on light, which the tokenMap states rather than overclaims. ⚘ (U+2698) ✿ (U+273F) ❀ (U+2740) are width-1 BMP, East-Asian-width N and outside the Unicode Emoji set, but not in the brief's listed-safe set; they are absent from Menlo and JetBrains Mono and render via the OS fallback (Apple Symbols / DejaVu), the same path as today's ✓. GLYPH therefore carries a second map (sprout `✧`, bloom `◆`, PLAN `◇`) selected by one glyph-support check at draw time, the same the kit uses for its other dingbats. ☼ U+263C is EAW N and not in the emoji set (its neighbours U+2600 to U+2602 are, so they are not used). `·` and `▁` are ambiguous-width like today's `━ ─`, so they inherit the same behaviour. The sway is a fg-colour fade between two hexes the Client is given, so a Client cell never swaps glyphs frame to frame except in the one-shots, which use only glyphs the static pane already draws. Hover `bg2` on rows is optional and needs no hook. Two-column inline layout at ≥ 96 columns keeps the same gutter in each column.
implementationNotes:
- view.tsx GLYPH → `{ todo: '·', doing: '⚘', done: '✿', blocked: '!', skipped: '–' }` with a fallback map `{ doing: '✧', done: '◆' }` (PLAN `❀` → `◇`) picked by the kit's glyph-support check; healthOf → `✗` error (D6), `!` error (attention), `✿` success (done), `☼` in the sun hex (working, replacing today's ▶); meter() → filled `✿`, empty `▁`; chips() → `✿ A` (success), `▸ B` (bold, no colour), `· C` (dim) joined with 3 spaces. No `claude` tone remains in the file.
- A `TINT` table in view.tsx: `{ dark: { sprout: '#c5e07a', trough: '#7f9252', sun: '#f2e3a0', pulse: '#fff6c8', rise: '#7c8c7c' }, light: { sprout: '#5e7a12', trough: '#7d943f', sun: '#a07c00', pulse: '#6c5b0d', rise: '#76857a' } }`; `view` state gains `paper: 'dark' | 'light'`, set by the hooks module at session start from `(await $.config.list()).find(r => r.key === 'theme')` (a string starting `dark` → dark, anything else → light) and again after `config.set` for key `theme` resolves (a pass-through hook: `next(e)` then re-pick).
- Band segments drop their ` · ` prefixes for two spaces and the count segment gets two spaces before the meter; the step segment's label becomes `⚘ B3 …` (the glyph a Text chip in the sprout hex inside the Button label, only when the step is doing); the health cell takes the sun hex when working; the `[?!~] n` right badges and their regex are untouched.
- rule() becomes section(): a Box with marginTop 1, a 1-cell gutter Text (glyph, toned `subtle` for ❀ ✦, `error`/`warning` for NEEDS YOU/NOTICED) and a bold label, tail right-aligned by a flexGrow spacer; no `─` fill. planBlock appends a `▁` soil Text (`subtle`, width columns − 3) only when isMono. The branch name is `subtle` too.
- Row accounting: needsRows + 1 (blank above), signalRows + 1 (blank above), planBlock + 2 when isMono (blank + soil) and + 1 otherwise (blank only), footer + 1; the single-column `stepRows = max(3, budget − needsRows − signalRows − 3)` subtracts those, and when it would fall below 3 the soil row is dropped first, then the SIGNALS ctx line; the inline two-column `budget − 3` path inherits the same + 1 per section.
- stepRow: gutter is a fixed-width 3 Box; the right column is a fixed-width Box (max right-string width in the block, computed once per draw) with `justifyContent: flex-end`, so alignment survives proportional fonts; show a linked running agent on todo steps too (`sonnet 1m`), `waits on Dn` in warning when a decision's blocks matches, drift age moves to the right column. Signals labels in a `width={6}` Box and step-detail labels in a `width={8}` Box with the value in a sibling Box, replacing padEnd.
- Footer: Buttons keep `hotkey` so the engine draws `1: Overview`; the active one is bold with no colour, the rest plain; gap 3; marginTop 1. Facts are joined by two spaces.
- Animation: a `Client` surface module `sprout.ts` with local phase state and `every(500)` (every(100) during a one-shot, then back), mounted twice: at the doing row's gutter (sway, ripen) and at the header's health cell (sunrise, pulse, finish). The hooks module passes the `TINT[paper]` hexes, an idle flag (set on key input, `$.clock` at 1 s) and the step, gate and needs-you transitions as props via update(); the Client only interpolates. Mobile and VS Code draw plain Text in the same hexes instead.
